summary: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc., a Tokyo-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer (BIOT/BIOTW), furnished a Form 6-K disclosing two Nasdaq deficiency notices. On September 9, 2026, Nasdaq flagged MVLS below US$50 million from July 28 to September 8, 2026, breaching Rule 5450(b)(2)(A); on September 10, 2026, MVPHS fell below US$15 million from July 29 to September 9, 2026, breaching Rule 5450(b)(2)(C). Each notice carries a 180-day cure window, to March 8 and March 9, 2027. Listing is unaffected pending cure; a Capital Market transfer or hearings appeal are alternatives. Watch for continued sub-threshold trading and delisting risk.
